headline: UN science panel warns AI-agent safeguards are unravelling
body: The UN Independent International Scientific Panel on AI issued its first thematic brief, warning that safeguards for capable AI agents are not keeping pace and urging precaution on loss-of-control risk. Coming from a top-credibility source, it weakened Alignment & Control, which lifts Conquerors and Zookeeper and pulls down the bright endings that need safe AI. It also counted as a small step toward Global Coordination. Capability kept climbing: OpenAI said an internal model resolved more than 100 additional open math problems, and Xiaomi open-sourced a 1-trillion-parameter model under an MIT licence, spreading power more widely. Conquerors moved ahead of 1984. Horizon Balance dropped to -5.80.
movers_note: Conquerors +0.8, mostly from the UN brief (+0.69) and OpenAI's maths claims (+0.16), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.08). Benevolent Dictator -0.6, from the UN brief (-0.50) and Xiaomi's open MiMo model (-0.07).
